description: Fed them, said both men were right, and turned the talk from the streets to the corn.
name: Jacqueline Field

description: Gave the comedy back in two parts, named forty pence, asked for the Holinshed, and did not ask a second time about the streets.
name: Richard Field

description: Kept the comedy and the Holinshed, gave the ages at home, and said the streets were quiet enough.
name: William Shakespeare
